fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.label: Slippage Check (expected out and tolerance, each Bits × 10^Exp)

docs: Accounts a calling program passes after the listed ones. Hylo's SDK passes none. A router seen on mainnet (Titan, through the account D5YqVMoSxnqeZAKAUUE1Dm3bmjtdxQ5DCF356ozqN9cM) passes three on every Hylo instruction it calls: the SOL/USD Pyth feed 7AviUf9nL62mcxNbQGKm4nKDQnPjswo6c5MX4D57HmyE, the hyUSD mint 5YMkXAYccHSGnHn9nob9xEvv6Pvka9DZWH7nTbotTu9E and the xSOL mint 4sWNB8zGWHkh6UnmwiEtzNxL4XrN7uK9tosbESbJFfVs. The program's source is not public, so whether it reads them is not established; they are shown, not named.

definedTypes.name: earnPoolDepositLock
docs: Earn pool deposit lock, engaged by a loss absorption that empties the pool.

definedTypes.name: feePair
docs: Represents the spread of fees between mint and redeem for protocol tokens.
All fees must be in basis points to represent a fractional percentage
directly applicable to a token amount e.g. `0.XXXX` or `bips x 10^-4`.

definedTypes.name: harvestCache
docs: Records epoch harvest information for offchain consumers.

definedTypes.name: poolDrawdown
docs: Outstanding hyUSD debt owed to the earn pool after a Depeg absorption.

definedTypes.name: rebalanceCurveConfig
docs: Floor/ceil deviation percentages for rebalance price curve construction.

definedTypes.name: slippageConfig
docs: Client specified slippage tolerance paired with expected token amount.

definedTypes.name: stablecoinFees
docs: **Deprecated** — retained only for `Hylo` account deserialization.

definedTypes.name: tokenMetadata
docs: Token metadata passed as an instruction argument.

definedTypes.name: ufixValue64
docs: A value-space `Fix` where base is always 10 and bits are a concrete type.
Intended for serialized storage in Solana accounts where generics won't work.

definedTypes.name: virtualStablecoin
docs: Simple counter representing the supply of a "virtual" stablecoin.

definedTypes.name: withdrawalLimiter
docs: Per-epoch withdrawal window, reset lazily on epoch rollover.

definedTypes.name: yieldHarvestConfig
docs: Captures yield harvest configuration as two basis point values:
